paragraphs.text:
Holding your trigger finger steady, you allow the reeking hulk 
in the rear of the cave to shuffle out into the light of your night 
fire. It is a gigantic biped with the face of an ape.
Make a Sanity roll: if you fail, lose 1D6 Sanity. Then, go to 493.
